name: history-locations
description: History sampling locations — where time-series histories are recorded. 'mark'/'numbers' annotate each point, 'pixel-size'/'scale' size the glyphs.
notes: Probe live with 'plot item create <type> ?' to list top-level keywords, then 'plot item create <type> <kw> ?' for sub-options. Keyword sets here are binary-validated against MassFlow 3D 9.

keywords.description: Show or hide the item without removing it.
keywords.name: active

keywords.description: Marker glyph drawn at each location.
keywords.name: mark

keywords.description: Annotate each location with its history number.
keywords.name: numbers

keywords.description: Scale factor for the drawn glyphs/vectors.
keywords.name: scale

keywords.description: Filter which entities are drawn using range elements (see references/range-elements).
keywords.name: range

keywords.description: Apply a 3D cutting plane to the item.
keywords.name: cut

keywords.description: Set item transparency (0 opaque .. 100 fully transparent).
keywords.name: transparency

examples.command: plot item create history-locations mark cross numbers on
examples.description: Show history sampling points with their numbers. Use case: Label history points
